title: Syllabus Overview
notes: Unit 9: Biota and Environment · B: Zoology · 10 teaching hours

• Animal adaptation: Aquatic (primary/secondary), Terrestrial (cursorial, fossorial, arboreal), Volant.
  • Animal behavior: Reflex action, taxes, dominance, leadership, fish and bird migration.
  • Environmental Pollution: Sources, effects, control measures of air, water, soil pollution; pesticides.
